verdict.rationale: Storing passkeys and using them to sign in to websites and apps is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. However, every piece of evidence describes TOTP/HOTP code management: QR scanning, setup keys, imports, backups and sharing. The single passkey mention (docs-14) refers to Ente offering passkeys as a way to secure the user's own Ente account, not storing passkeys for other services, so it is not credited here.
